scope: AST syntax compilation only; no evaluation, runtime caller adoption, or production deployment

benchmark.methodology: Three serial pairs, Rust then TypeScript each round, same capped container and identical inputs. Rust optimized release example; Node JIT. Compilation and AST construction/destruction/GC only, no evaluator or timed JSON serialization/checksum. Semantic checksums checked before timing. Report median of 21 batch per-operation means per runtime/input (7 batches x 3 rounds). These local microbenchmarks do not predict production end-to-end latency or isolate individual optimization contributions. Fixed order, shared production host and different allocators/GC can affect results. Plan reuse traversal was disabled.
